Description: Verify the Previous / Next footer is sticky and stays visible while the panel content scrolls under it. Covers AC-1.
Test name: TC-GEO-1166-001 - Footer stays sticky at every panel scroll position
Test step: Given the user is on the "Action Center" page of the Toyota analysis
Expected result: The "Target Sources" list is displayed with the tabs "All", "Improve visibility", "Improve perception" and the ranked sources
QA Precondition: User logged in on staging (org QA-GEO). Toyota analysis https://staging-geo.onclusive.com/geo/dashboard/439acd96-0b1b-4da4-9e07-612d38e9783e is completed and its Action Center lists target sources (261 on 2026-10-02).

Test name: TC-GEO-1166-001 - Footer stays sticky at every panel scroll position
Test step: When the user opens the details panel of the source ranked #1
Expected result: The details panel opens over the list with a footer showing "Previous" (left), "Source 1 of N" (center) and "Next source" (right)

Test name: TC-GEO-1166-001 - Footer stays sticky at every panel scroll position
Test step: And the user scrolls the panel content to the middle
Expected result: The articles and prompts scroll under the footer; "Previous", "Source 1 of N" and "Next source" stay visible at the bottom of the panel

Test name: TC-GEO-1166-001 - Footer stays sticky at every panel scroll position
Test step: And the user scrolls the panel content to the very bottom
Expected result: The end of "Prompts associated with this source" is reachable and the footer is still visible and not overlapping hidden content

Test name: TC-GEO-1166-001 - Footer stays sticky at every panel scroll position
Test step: Then the user scrolls back to the top of the panel
Expected result: The footer remains fixed at the bottom of the panel at every scroll position
